rules.rule: Import everything from the package root. There are no subpath imports for components and none will be added.

Theme, material, radius and elevation are set once on FujiProvider. No component takes a theme, material, radius or elevation prop. Theme and material are independent - either theme renders in either material. Glass has no separate tint - the active theme is the glass tint.
Icon props take a component reference, imported individually. Never a string name.
Controlled inputs use `value` + `onValueChange` (or `onChange`); uncontrolled use `defaultValue`. Passing both makes the component controlled and the default is ignored.
Tailwind's scanner is static, so a class name assembled at runtime is never compiled. Write full class strings and branch between them.

A Server Component may render a compound root, but must not read a sub-part off it (`Dialog.Content`) - the client-module binding does not carry static properties across the boundary. Import the named sub-export instead.
An icon-only control has no text, so it needs an explicit accessible name.
The package ships pre-compiled CSS and no Tailwind preflight. Import the stylesheet once at the app root; consumers do not need Tailwind themselves.
rules.bad: // relying on the consuming app's own Tailwind build to produce Fuji's classes
